results.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2024 Mustang vehicles.  The Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) may not illuminate at startup or while driving.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 101, "Control and Displays" and 102, "Transmission shift lever sequence, starter interlock, and transmission braking effect."
results.Consequence: An instrument panel display that does not show critical information, such as warning lights or vehicle speed, increases the risk of a crash.
results.Remedy: Dealers will update the instrument panel cluster software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on February 25, 2025.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 24C35.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.
